identity.name: Associated Press
identity.description: A not-for-profit cooperative news agency producing global breaking news, politics, business and investigative reporting distributed to member outlets and clients.

ownership.ownershipNotes: AP is an unincorporated not-for-profit cooperative owned by its member news organisations. It is not government-owned, though it sells content and data services commercially.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Cooperative governance and published AP standards emphasise nonpartisan, fact-based reporting; the wire is widely used as a neutral baseline by outlets across the political spectrum.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates AP Left-Center with High factual reporting, but its straight-news file is structurally nonpartisan and supplies both conservative and liberal member outlets.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic reporting is explanatory and source-driven rather than advocacy-led.

internationalAlignment.evidence: A US-headquartered global wire with strong American institutional access and a broad international file.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; AP is a primary source for election calls, official statements and breaking news.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Institutional, nonpartisan wire copy with particular authority in US politics, elections and official accountability. It favours confirmed facts and named sourcing over interpretation.
knownWeaknesses: No public direct RSS access verified

selectionRationale: AP is a benchmark wire for factual cross-checking and US election coverage. It complements Reuters geographically and institutionally, but cannot be activated without a feed.

research.researchNotes: AP's official About page was accessible, but AP News RSS and Arc outbound feeds returned Cloudflare 403. No reliable public feed; no activation recommendation. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
